Class DefaultTopicResolver

java.lang.Object
org.apache.pulsar.spring.core.DefaultTopicResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
TopicResolver, Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware, BeanFactoryAware
public class DefaultTopicResolver extends Object implements TopicResolver, BeanFactoryAware, BeanClassLoaderAware
Topic resolver that accepts custom type to topic mappings and uses the mappings during topic resolution.

Message type to topic mappings can be configured with addCustomTopicMapping(Class, String).
